column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a leg” is rendered “the thigh.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will not meet anyone” is rendered “I will not arbitrate with a man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “queen” (gevereth) is rendered “The Lady.”
Close to the Hebrew; “compassion” is rendered “mercy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “queen” is rendered “a lady,” and “its outcome” “the latter end of them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I and only I [am] yet” is rendered “I am, and there is no one else besides me.”
Close to the Hebrew; “led you away” is rendered “warped you.”
NKJV renders שַׁחְרָהּ (“to charm it away” or “its dawn”) as “from where it arises,” and “cover” (atone) as “put it off.”
Close to the Hebrew; “inspire awe” is rendered “prevail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “those who divide the heavens… make known at new moons” is rendered “the astrologers… the monthly prognosticators.”
Close to the Hebrew; “side” is rendered “quarter.”
